About

I am Deon. I build because waiting for perfect conditions got boring.

I’m a Zimbabwean founder and full-stack builder based in Poland. The distance between those two places shapes more of the work than any job title does.

The short version

I build products that need to work outside a design file: a ride platform for Zimbabwe, a gym app used at an actual front desk, a consumer brand finding its voice, and a cross-border finance idea that has to respect the difficult parts before it can promise the easy ones.

I work long shifts in Poland. I still make room to build. That has made me less interested in founder performance and more interested in whether the next release is genuinely better.

Zimbabwe taught me urgency.
Poland taught me endurance.

A few things I believe

Context beats imitation.

A product for an African market should not feel like a smaller copy of one built elsewhere.

Boring operations matter.

Verification, support, access history and failure states are part of the product.

Good taste needs evidence.

A beautiful interface earns its keep by making the next action clearer.

What I refuse to build
  • A product that hides weak thinking behind animation.
  • A feature whose only reason is “everyone else has it.”
  • A promise the operation cannot keep.
  • A brand with no opinion of its own.

If it needs a real answer,
email me.
